title: Is exercise safe after 50?
subtitle: Evidence-based answer to the common question: is exercise safe after 50?
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports general safety and significant health benefits of appropriately prescribed exercise after age 50. Moderate and well-supervised exercise programs reduce risks associated with aging and chronic disease. Evidence for specific modalities (e.g., high-intensity training) remains emerging and requires individualized assessment.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
